title: DeleLuz · Phone v3 (combined, 3 skins)
brief: Option 1's five tabs plus the best of four AI references: segmented strip ribbon, power dock, scene tiles, clear reconnect states, ruler and ± steppers, and an optional quick-action floating button. Six 390×844 phone screens per skin.

artboards.title: Ember (warm)
artboards.tradeoff: Warm charcoal and amber with a glowing neon ribbon: cozy and residential; less precise for pixel work.

artboards.title: Graphite (technical)
artboards.tradeoff: Cool graphite and cyan with a ruler-marked pixel instrument: exact and technical; feels more like a tool than a home app.

artboards.title: Prism (neutral)
artboards.tradeoff: Neutral glass UI tinted by the live light color, neon ribbon in control and ruler in the pixel editor: most adaptive; accent changes with every color.
